implementation.dimensions: The planner and dendrogram now share measured fixed-font field metrics. Native default500x243; (Width,Height)20:5,35:9,15:3,60:20 produce200x118,350x218,150x68,600x493. Other pairs remain outside pixel acceptance and use fallback/notice.
implementation.axes: Vertical axis x23 from y9; horizontal axis at height-18 reaches width-2. The numeric range is0..3.5. Label step is0.5*ceil(15/(0.5*scale)), where scale=(height-27)/3.5; small fields show integer or1.5 ticks. Numeric baselines use rounded graph positions plus4px.
implementation.branches: Four fixed native leaves occupy fractions1/8,3/8,5/8,7/8 of the plot; parent positions1/4 and3/4 are rounded independently from continuous coordinates. Subtrees join at2 and1, top branch at3. Navy128 lines are one pixel wide; axes169 and text51 stay the same for inactive inputs.
implementation.text: Shared regular13px Liberation Sans/FreeType LCD with normal composition and existing hinted kerning. Captions center with ceiling rounding, not branch-coordinate rounding. Overflow uses the longest prefix plus three ASCII periods strictly narrower than the label cell. No whole-widget bitmap, glyph fragments or paint tables are stored.
implementation.sourceSemantics: Native export removes Font, BackColor and BorderColor. Explicit12pt/16pt-bold inputs retain regular13px internal text. ReadOnly and Enabled change only the outer border from160 to232 in the recorded matrix. Requested/canonical XML are both preserved; no BSL executes. Typed applicability and inherited style semantics remain open.
implementation.nativeAnimation: Initial opening animates branch growth and temporarily uses another line color. References wait at least2 seconds, then require two consecutive equal full-control RGB comparisons. Earlier animated captures are preserved as transient investigation, not accepted blank/partial data or a mask. The viewer displays the settled static preview.
implementation.nativeCapture: The full600x493 field is stitched only from two visible native viewports with zero RGB differences over the overlap and a verified bottom border. Native sessions are closed with host namespace /proc and X11 verification.
implementation.lifecycle: Solid outer DOM and selected identity survive dirty size and ignored appearance changes, actual floating updates and reattachment. Repaints follow model, region/locale, resize and zoom. Existing lazy regular face is reused, with no dependency or WASM changes.
implementation.testEnvironment: Main and active floating isolated IDE windows use stock fullscreen. Dedicated capture hashes every RGB pixel of the actual visible complete control; there is no offscreen-render replacement, tolerance or mask.
implementation.scopeGate: Linux/DPR1/zoom100, en-US and the five recorded dimension pairs. Other conditions retain browser fallback and the existing localized approximation notice. Other properties/styles/cultures/dimensions/combinations and full forms remain open.

preAcceptanceFailures.reason: The outer SpecialField wrapper applied the inapplicable BorderColor even though the inner full source proof matched. Native border decisions now use a measured dendrogram helper; the unit matrix checks border color against native RGB for every row, including ignored explicit blue.
